title: How to book a gaming cafe near you with Hash
description: Find gaming cafes near you, compare PC, PlayStation, Xbox, VR and racing setups, and book a slot in advance on the Hash app. Here is how it works.

body.text: Walking into a gaming cafe only to find every PC taken is a familiar story. With Hash you can see what a cafe has and book your slot before you leave home.
Open the Hash app to see gaming cafes near you, with their setups, timings and photos. You can tell at a glance which cafes have gaming PCs, PlayStation, Xbox, VR or racing rigs.
Choose the station you want and a time slot that suits you. Bookings are charged at the cafe's own rate.
Pay with Hash Pay in the app or pay at the cafe. Either way, your slot is held for you.
When you arrive, start your session on the cafe's Hash kiosk and play. There is no waiting at the counter, and the session ends automatically when your time is up.
Why book instead of walking in?

items: Your PC or console is ready when you arrive, even at busy times.
You can plan a session with friends and make sure there are enough stations for everyone.
Every session booked through Hash earns HashCoins, which you can spend on game passes and offers.

body.text: Cafe owners can list their cafe on Hash to get advance bookings from players nearby, run every PC with the Hash kiosk and see sessions, consoles, customers and earnings on one dashboard. Start on the list your cafe page on our website.
